name: Koffie: automatisch uit na 60 minuten
what_it_does: Turns the coffee machine off after 60 minutes on, and sends a notification with a button to turn it back on.

name: Koffie: uit om 22:00
what_it_does: Turns the coffee machine off at 22:00 if it's still on, so it never stays on overnight.

name: Robb smarrt 8-button switch keuken
what_it_does: Handles the 8-button switch in the kitchen.
